description: This PHP class 'SchedulerMigrationService' handles migration of scheduler jobs from legacy Google Calendar sync to a new calendar sync system within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for validation, finding legacy schedulers, checking for existing new schedulers, performing migration, and reporting status.

classes.name: SchedulerMigrationService
classes.description: A service class for migrating scheduler jobs from legacy Google Calendar sync to a new system, including validation, migration, and status reporting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database and logger dependencies, throws exceptions if dependencies are not available.

methods.name: validateSchedulerMigrationRequirements
methods.description: Checks if the 'schedulers' table exists and if the 'Scheduler' class is available.

methods.name: findLegacyGoogleSyncSchedulers
methods.description: Retrieves active, non-deleted schedulers with job 'syncGoogleCalendar'.

methods.name: hasNewCalendarSyncScheduler
methods.description: Checks if a new calendar sync scheduler already exists.

methods.name: migrateScheduler
methods.description: Performs migration of legacy schedulers to new system, with dry run option.

methods.name: getSchedulerMigrationStatus
methods.description: Provides a summary of migration status including counts and existing schedulers.
